item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 12/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will develop over the coast of western Guangdong today and tomorrow, and extend eastwards afterwards. Its associated heavy showers and thunderstorms will affect the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary over the weekend. With the trough of low pressure departing, showers will lessen gradually over Guangdong early next week. Another trough of low pressure will affect southern China midweek next week.
